title: The Lie group nodes in the local Jacobians: dv/dq and the rigid body ODE2 Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: On NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG and NodeRigidBodyRotVecDataLG the markers return no GetVelocity_q and ObjectRigidBody is differentiated numerically by CSystem, which composes the rotations. Decided: closed forms on the local angular velocity coordinates of these nodes.
